a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of reaching 8 first means we both almost certainly die. Reaching 8 needs at least two rounds of operating, and the odds of no storm for two rounds are 4%. I don't think the agreement can work, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than breaking it quietly. If you see a fairer option that actually survives the storm odds, tell me and I'll consider it.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I'm sorry; I don't think the plan could survive the storm odds. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round with you until the reserve has 4 for you, and I won't take anything more.
